sinopsis.es: En una pequeña aldea kosovar, una cineasta ayuda a su padre exiliado a reconstruir su infancia con la ayuda de los habitantes del lugar, revelando recuerdos personales, historias familiares olvidadas y las huellas de un pasado borrado por la guerra.
sinopsis.en: After her father Asllan has lived in exile for sixty years, Dea returns with him to Makermal. This Kosovar village that was once his home was destroyed in the war, leaving only the stories of the survivors. Together with the remaining villagers, Swiss-Kosovar director Dea Gjinovci and her father embark on a search for traces of the past and are confronted with the collective scars of a community.
